transition.feasible_moves: no-op or exactly one internal sense-codon replacement

enumeration.rejection_rule: uniform valid-state proposal; accept iff Hamming distance from kernel start <= 2
enumeration.rejection_comparison: exhaustively enumerate every proposal and normalize the accepted set exactly
enumeration.naive_bias_reference: uniform distribution over every state reachable within two feasible transitions
enumeration.telescope_target: uniform over all valid length-3 states reachable after two transitions

event_time.ordered_times_given_kappa: order statistics of iid Uniform(0,1), with constant joint density kappa! on the ordered simplex
